import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
#check_failure MvPolynomial.taylor
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_unique
#check @MvPolynomial.comp_aeval
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_X
#check @MvPolynomial.algHom_C
#check @Polynomial.taylor
#check @Polynomial.taylorAlgHom
#check @Polynomial.taylorEquiv
namespace TaylorAssessment
universe u v
noncomputable def translate {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) :
    MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
  MvPolynomial.aeval fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.X j + MvPolynomial.C (α j)
example {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) :
    translate α = MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.X j + MvPolynomial.C (α j)) := rfl
#synth Algebra ℕ (MvPolynomial (Type 1) ℕ)
#check (translate (fun _ : Type 1 ↦ (0 : ℕ)) : MvPolynomial (Type 1) ℕ →ₐ[ℕ] _)
example {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) (P Q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    translate α (P * Q) = translate α P * translate α Q := map_mul _ _ _
noncomputable def translateEquiv {σ R : Type*} [CommRing R] (α : σ → R) :
    MvPolynomial σ R ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R where
  __ := translate α
  invFun := translate (fun j ↦ -α j)
  left_inv P := by
    simp [translate, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply]
  right_inv P := by
    simp [translate, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply]
example {σ R : Type*} [CommRing R] (α : σ → R) :
    Function.Injective (translate α : MvPolynomial σ R → _) := (translateEquiv α).injective
#print axioms translate
#print axioms translateEquiv
end TaylorAssessment
